I am sure you can even do better Havent looked in the problem tho yet We have geth as a dependency in prysm already, wondering if it makes sense to export any of these functions so we would use the same for our end of blob json processing My guess is that unmarshaling doesn’t suffer from the same issue. The json.Marshal() problem comes from the validation/compaction pass that runs on already valid bytes, and in Geth’s RPC stack that ends up happening at two different layers. For unmarshaling, I’m thinking that it's a single parse pass, so there probably isn't redundant work to eliminate in the same way. I imagine that it's still a bit slower than ideal due to reflection, but not pathologically so. i could be wrong though. It'd be pretty easy to benchmark the marshalling and unmarshalling of the execution payload envelope with 72 blobs and see if unmarshalling is slow too.
